prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop web UI comp at 1536x1024 for the self-hosted IMAP MCP account's user-token management page, using the attached screenshot as the approved visual reference for its overall light SaaS admin layout, quiet gray background, compact left navigation, simple typography, white surfaces, clear blue primary action, and one-time-token panel. Preserve that visual language and information density. Replace its fictitious brand and unrelated navigation with a small “Mailstack MCP” wordmark, the connected mailbox email, one “Access tokens” navigation item, and sign-out only. Main content heading “Access tokens” and short helper line; top-right “Create token” button. The central area must show a real token list (two rows) with token label, created date, last used, status, and an action to delete/revoke each token. Expand one row to show per-tool permissions with familiar labeled toggles and allowed/not allowed state for list_mailboxes, read_message, set_message_flags, and send_email; mark send_email as available only when SMTP is configured. Keep a one-time token state in a right-side card with a clear warning that the full token is shown once and a copy button, but do not claim it expires or can only be used once. No billing, projects, team, account settings, dashboard or search features. Do not invent a company name, user name, extra mailbox account, usage expiry, or fake metrics. User should understand the job from this screenshot alone. Keep primary action and all controls accessible and readable. This image is a full software surface, not a poster; content is data and controls, not photography.
